definitions.information: conditional coefficient information; same production posterior and fixed noise prior
definitions.targeted_information: conditional Gaussian response-response mutual information on an actual excluded query; no response labels used
definitions.contribution: log score with supporting fact minus score without it on another actual excluded fact; fixed coordinates
definitions.ranking: recorded pre-draft binding candidates, not decoded utterance candidates
definitions.scope: current relation evidence contribution; proposal for valuation, not a deployed reward or causal-identification certificate
